protocols.evidenceNotes: Secondary commercial source; the details below are the source's own statements, not independently verified clinical guidance. No established human dose. The page reports research-community HNG conventions of about 500–1,000 mcg SC 2–3 times weekly in short cycles; HNG is an analog and far more potent than native Humanin. Preclinical only; no human trials.

schedule.description: Source says 2–3 times weekly in short cycles; this refers to HNG analog conventions, not a validated native Humanin dose.

regimen.notes: HNG is an analog, not native Humanin, and is described as substantially more potent. No human trials or validated dose.
